scythe_long.note: the repaired strips' whole straight scythe (cut from work skill 3, shaft redrawn straight): pommel left, blade right, joint = grip on the shaft (shaft core rows 7-8). Use on the 'scythe' part: ['sprite', 'scythe_long'] then deg/flip/at - matches the kept repaired frames' scythe size.

hips.note: Leg pairs (legs_crouch, legs_lunge, legs_tuck, legs_hang, legs_kneel): both legs in one sprite drawn from the design's own legs, joint = the hips' middle, which goes on the design's hips' middle (canvas 64, 85 = the torso joint). Use the pseudo-part 'hips': put 'hips' in the frame's 'order' where 'far_leg' was (behind 'far_arm', as the design draws the legs) and leave out 'far_leg' and 'near_leg', parts {'hips': [['sprite', 'legs_crouch', [64, 85]], ...more ops]}, and 'move': [0, drop] (the sprite's 'drop') so the hips come down with the body and the soles stand on the soles' row (tuck and hang have drop 0 and their feet off the ground: lift the figure with 'move'). 'low' = rows from the joint to the sprite's lowest pixel. Put 'hips' after 'far_arm' when a thigh must pass in front of the far hand (tuck, lunge). Drawn by work/ka/base_cut/legs_base.py.
